question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

My brother goes for swimming every day _________ summer.
solution:
The correct answer is '**during**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**during**" is used to indicate a period of time in which something happens. (के दौरान)
 
• In this sentence, "during summer" is the most appropriate option as it correctly specifies when the activity (swimming) takes place.
 
• The other options: "**at**", "**for**", and "**thoroughly**" do not fit the context as appropriately as "**during**".

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *My brother goes for swimming every day during__ summer.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **At (पर)**: Refers to a specific point or location but does not indicate a period of time in this context.
 
• **For (के लिए)**: Indicates purpose or duration but is not the correct choice here.
 
• **Thoroughly (पूरी तरह से)**: Indicates completeness but is irrelevant in this context.
